messages:
gabi: quick postmortem sync notes — pattern: broad flag releases + weak canary gates = fast user-impact. want to lock down remediation owners and a compact checklist we can apply to every rollout. short proposal below.

gabi: Proposal (bite-sized):
- "Sheriff" canary checks (small automated guard process that validates key health metrics before each ramp)
- Flag metadata schema (rollback_safe, max_rollout_pct, default_scope, owner)
- Immediate containment playbook (auto-quarantine + traffic-shed steps)
- Telemetry augmentation (per-flag heatmap + decay-adjusted baseline)
- Regular incident patterns doc + recurring KR for reducing mean-blast-size

harry: I can own the Sheriff canary checks. thinking: run a 5m pre-ramp probe at 1% + compare to rolling 30m baseline. Fail -> hold and page. ETA: 8 days.

irene: I'll do flag metadata schema + naming conv. propose: <service>.<area>.<feature>.<env>. Add max_rollout_pct default 5% for prod. ETA: 4 days.

john: containment playbook owner here. I'll draft a 1-pager runbook with step-by-step CLI commands, ops dashboard links, and a checklist for product owners. Also adding a 'quarantine' tag in Console for impacted flags. ETA: 6 days.

kate: telemetry + heatmap dashboards I can take. will add decay-adjusted baseline (we use EWMA) for low-traffic flags to avoid noise. ETA: 10 days.

gabi: For Sheriff checks, please include p95 latency, 5xx rate, error-rate trend (slope) and a simple anomaly score threshold. Keep conservative defaults but make them tunable per-service.

harry: agreed. default thresholds: 5xx increase >2pp absolute OR p95 >1.8x baseline OR anomaly_score > 4 (z-score-ish) for 5m.

irene: naming + schema will include owner tag (team/email) so alerts can page the right group, and a rollback_safe boolean. docs will have examples for rollout.yaml.

harry: sample Sheriff config (WIP):
```yaml
sheriff_check:
  enabled: true
  probe_pct: 1
  probe_duration_mins: 5
  baseline_window_mins: 30
  triggers:
    - metric: error_rate
      absolute_increase_pct: 2.0
      duration_mins: 5
    - metric: p95_latency
      multiplier: 1.8
      duration_mins: 5
    - metric: anomaly_score
      threshold: 4
  on_fail: hold_and_page
```

john: containment playbook note: we should add an explicit step to reduce rollout to 0% (not just rollback) when stateful changes might be left half-applied. Also include contact matrix.

kate: dashboards will include per-flag activation hist, traffic split, and a weekly "blast radius" KPI (avg % of users impacted per incident). That KPI will be part of our SLOs for the quarter.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4900 -> "Sheriff canary checks implementation" (assignee: harry, due: 8d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4901 -> "Flag metadata schema & naming conv" (assignee: irene, due: 4d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4902 -> "Containment playbook + quarantine tag" (assignee: john, due: 6d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4903 -> "Per-flag telemetry + blast-radius KPI" (assignee: kate, due: 10d).

gabi: one design question: do we allow automatic rollback for flags that flip DB-backed behavior? recommend default: auto-rollback only for stateless toggles. For others, Sheriff should hold and page.

harry: +1. add metadata field rollback_safe: true required to enable auto-rollback. otherwise fail -> page.

irene: adding max_rollout_pct per-env and per-service. I'll bake that into the template.

gabi: next steps: owners update tickets with blocking deps and list of dashboards/PRs by EOD Wed. we'll run a quick policy review on Thurs 11:00. If anyone can't meet ETA, flag now.

john: pinging security for potential audit log retention changes.

kate: noted, will include retention reqs in telemetry ticket.

gabi: thanks team. goal: halve median blast size by end of next quarter with these controls. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: policy review Thu 11:00 (channel: #eng-platform).
